summary: Pyxis Oncology filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $110.0M underwritten public offering of 36,047,919 common shares plus pre-funded warrants for 1,883,121 shares, each bundled with common warrants for 1.3 shares at a $3.50 strike (49,310,352 warrant shares). Combined price was $2.90 per share/pre-funded warrant, versus a $2.90 September 29, 2026 last sale. Underwriting discounts totaled $6.6M, netting $103.4M before expenses, with Leerink, Guggenheim and Wells Fargo as joint bookrunners. Warrant exercise is conditioned on shareholder approval of a charter amendment raising authorized shares; watch that vote and OS data timing.
